  shipping_limit_date,
  order_approved_at,
  CAST(shipping_limit_date AS DATE) as sl_date,
  CAST(order_approved_at AS DATE) as oa_date,
  (CAST(shipping_limit_date AS DATE) - CAST(order_approved_at AS DATE)) as diff_days
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LIMIT 5

        THEN (CAST(strftime('%s', shipping_limit_date) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(strftime('%s', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DOUBLE)) / 3600.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_processing_hours
